author: SickProdigy
description: Create bot-branded update drafts from project and upstream references, collect trusted human edits, require final approval, and publish to subscribed servers.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores configured editor and publisher user IDs, proposal author IDs and text, approval history, guild channel and optional role IDs, source references, and delivery history. User-data deletion removes configured access and anonymizes retained draft history.
install_msg: BotUpdates is disabled for delivery until each server subscribes. Configure a private review channel and trusted editors before publishing.
name: BotUpdates
